name: Canyon
desc: Being funnelled - one way in, one way out, and walls that decide where you go.
tags: scenery, no humans, canyon, layered red sandstone walls, striated rock strata, canyon floor, dry riverbed, boulders, walls rising both sides, narrow strip of sky above, shaft of light down the wall
prose: a canyon of layered red sandstone, striated walls rising close on both sides, a dry boulder-strewn riverbed along the floor and only a narrow strip of sky visible overhead
note: Defaults to a Grand Canyon overlook - a view FROM the rim, not a place a character can stand in. Say you are on the floor: canyon floor, dry riverbed, walls rising on both sides, strip of sky above. Slot canyon and wide canyon are two different places and mixing their tags gives a muddy compromise, so pick one. Layered strata is what stops the walls rendering as smooth grey putty.
